toc.title: WiggleUI
toc.author: baudin
toc.notes: Ctrl-click raid marking, casting on what the mouse is over with a key you bound by dragging the spell into a slot, a Charge button that aims by camera out of combat, a character sheet of the addon's own with your gear, your skills, your standings and how often you miss on it, a socketing window opened by shift-clicking a piece on that sheet with every gem in your bags under its holes, a talent window with all three trees side by side and nothing to scroll and what unlearning them would cost along the bottom, a spell book with one row per spell and every rank you know folded behind a button beside it, a warrior bar loadout, threat-coloured enemy bars, damage healing and threat meters, a nag for the sharpening stone and the racial you forgot, two rows of cooldowns, a shaman's four totem slots with a hole where one is missing, the seconds a fight is made of over the minutes, square class-coloured player and target frames, party and raid blocks ordered by role, your own cast bar, a square minimap with the addon buttons collected behind one square, a chat window of the addon's own with a room per conversation in place of the client's, groups for the people who matter and a voice channel joined at login, a loot stream and a combat log drawn as scrolling feeds with the addon's own tooltips on them, the addon's own tooltip on a creature you point at in the world with where you stand on it under the name, a mail window that colours a recipient green for one of yours, blue for somebody you know and red for a stranger and splits more than twelve attachments across as many mails as it takes, a quest log three columns wide with every quest you are on down the left grouped by zone, what this one wants in the middle and what it pays on the right, a dungeon log the same three columns wide with every boss in the game down the left in level order, the dungeon's own map in the middle with the ones you have looted marked on it and what this one drops on the right, one window for your bags with what you are carrying sorted into piles and how many slots are free counted along the bottom, a filter for the red text in the middle of the screen, fast looting, trash selling, repairs paid for you, a whispered thank you to a stranger who buffs you, five seconds of the eighties every time you level, a longer camera, a carried Edit Mode layout and stripped bar art.

candidates.description: Healing frames for WoW Forever: click-casting at the rank you choose, missing buffs, dispels, healer mana. Every feature optional, in English and French.

toc.title: Lyorune |cff33dd88(Forever)|r
toc.author: BellaDroode
toc.notes: Cadres de soin simples, rapides et élégants pour WoW Forever : clic-soin de tous vos soins et buffs au rang de votre choix, avec variantes sur un ennemi, en JcJ, sur un tank et hors combat, aucun soin envoyé sur un ennemi, bijoux et macros, touches au survol, statistiques de vos clics et carnet de soigneur avec bilan du jour, soins entrants, boucliers et ce qui reste à absorber même en combat, icônes d'auras visibles en combat et rangées à la mesure de chaque forme de case, icônes placées par défaut sans se couvrir, placement, taille et affichage de chaque élément de la case (la place d'un élément masqué profite aux autres) propres à chaque personnage, mana basse des soigneurs et soigneurs qui boivent, vos sorts externes, Âme affaiblie et Longanimité avec leurs secondes, liseré de mana basse et règle des 5 secondes, gros défensifs et contrôles des joueurs, dissipation (jusqu'à 3 par case, image et couleur du type, secondes restantes), affaiblissements tous, utiles ou ceux que vous dissipez, Âme affaiblie et Longanimité toujours montrées et liste à cocher, votre liste toujours en tête et reconnue même en combat, joueurs en bonne santé estompés, distance, buffs manquants des quatre classes de soigneurs dans un bandeau fin sous les cadres (listes JcE et JcJ) et vos buffs à reposer en gris sur chaque case, la même partout, votre buff unique en temps réel avec ses charges, vie basse en liseré fixe en combat, raccourcis du jeu, recharge globale, vos recharges, vos totems et les recharges du groupe sous les cadres, icônes de classe et des DPS au choix, rôle du druide d'après ses talents, trait de canalisation (Pénitence), annonces de mana faible et remontée même avec la mana cachée, familiers en face de leur maître, joueurs épinglés, répartition des soigneurs et des buffs (groupes à buffer, bénédiction par joueur, entente entre paladins), signal, thèmes, fenêtre d'options à chapitres avec case témoin et recherche, profils (champ de bataille, copie par partie), partage, canal des soigneurs en français et en anglais, page « Les amis de Lyorune », tutoriel intégré.

localizedNotes.enUS: Simple, fast and elegant healing frames for WoW Forever: click-casting of all your heals and buffs at the rank you choose, with variants on an enemy, in PvP, on a tank and out of combat, no heal ever sent to an enemy, trinkets and macros, hover keys, click statistics and healer's notebook with today's summary, incoming heals, shields and what is left to absorb even in combat, aura icons visible in combat and laid out to fit each cell shape, default icon places that never overlap, position, size and visibility of every cell element (a hidden element's room goes to the others) for each character, healers' low mana and drinking healers, your external spells, Weakened Soul and Forbearance with their seconds, low mana screen edge and five second rule, players' big defensives and crowd control, dispels (up to 3 per cell, type picture and colour, seconds left), debuffs all, useful or those you dispel, Weakened Soul and Forbearance always shown and a checklist, your own list always first and recognized even in combat, healthy players faded, range, missing buffs for the four healing classes in a thin strip under the frames (PvE and PvP lists) and a your buffs to cast again in grey on each cell, the same everywhere, your unique buff in real time with its charges, low health as a steady edge in combat, game key bindings, global cooldown, your cooldowns, your totems and the group's cooldowns under the frames, optional class and DPS icons, druid role from talents, channel line (Penance), low mana and mana restored announcements even with hidden mana, pets facing their owner, pinned players, healer and buff assignments (buff groups, blessing per player, paladin agreement), pings, themes, options window in chapters with a live preview cell and search, profiles (battleground, partial copy), sharing, healers' channel in French and in English, Friends of Lyorune page, built-in tutorial.

tocs.title: Commander Bags
tocs.author: Devin
tocs.notes: Draws quality borders and bind-status padlocks on bag items, sorts bags on demand, remembers bag positions, and fades bags while moving. With Commander Orders, Go to Vendor and Go to Repair (settings page, /cb vendor, /cb repair) point the arrow at the nearest one.

tocs.title: Commander Chat
tocs.author: Devin
tocs.notes: Shrink chat to a footnote: size, scale, and font controls, mouseover-only fading, tab hiding, world-channel muting, plus visibility toggles and sound pings.

tocs.title: Commander Idle
tocs.author: Devin
tocs.notes: RTS idle-worker alert in the world; in a battleground, one silent countdown to being thrown out (auto-AFK, or the report ladder if you get reported).

tocs.title: Commander Ping
tocs.author: Devin
tocs.notes: RTS-style minimap ping alerts: sound, an expanding flash, and a callout whenever a group member pings the map. With Commander Orders, the callout's [Go] link points the arrow at the pinged spot, or every ping can become a waypoint by itself.

tocs.title: Commander Buffs
tocs.author: Devin
tocs.notes: Player buffs and debuffs on the player unit frame wearing Blizzard's own aura art — with the client's aura frames hidden — plus a loss-of-control light on your portrait: stunned, silenced, feared, rooted, named in a word the instant it lands, with a radial duration ring. The whole policy is editable…

tocs.title: Commander Comms
tocs.author: Devin
tocs.notes: A radial quick-message wheel: one keypress, ten battle calls, routed to raid, party, or say automatically. Rally on Me in the middle of the wheel says where you are, and with Commander Orders sends your spot to the group as a waypoint to follow.

tocs.title: Commander Debug
tocs.author: Devin
tocs.notes: Collects every Lua error raised since login — read out of BugGrabber when it is installed, captured by its own error hook when it is not — and hands the whole pile over as one markdown prompt, ready to paste into Claude.

tocs.title: Commander Guide
tocs.author: Devin
tocs.notes: A raid guide in the game, boss by boss, written for the seat you are in. Open it and read the healer's page for the boss in front of you: the fight in one line, your job, the phases, the debuffs to dispel. Then let it talk: the voice reads the brief when you target the boss, and during the pull it t…

tocs.title: Commander Kicks
tocs.author: Devin
tocs.notes: An interrupt bar for arena and battlegrounds -- the oldest arena addon there is, rebuilt on this suite's rules. Every enemy interrupt (Kick, Pummel, Shield Bash, Counterspell, Earth Shock, Spell Lock, Silencing Shot, Silence, Feral Charge, Arcane Torrent) as an icon with a clock, so "can I cast righ…

tocs.title: Commander Suite
tocs.author: Devin
tocs.notes: Suite dashboard: module directory, quick settings access, and suite-wide tools.

tocs.title: Commander Vault
tocs.author: Devin
tocs.notes: The bank, commanded — one unified window over every bank slot and bank bag, grouped into sections, searchable by quality, slot, item level and how long a thing has been sitting there, sortable in a pass that gives slots back rather than merely tidying, and browsable from anywhere in the world. tocs.title: Forever Atlas
tocs.author: Christian Presley
tocs.notes: A map window with smooth zoom in the place of the world map, coordinates on the map and on screen, waypoints with a direction arrow, map notes, and the quest and NPC pins of the game.

tocs.title: Forever Meter
tocs.author: Christian Presley
tocs.notes: A damage and healing meter for solo play, parties and raids: bars for each player, your own DPS on screen, fights to look back at, a spell breakdown and reports to chat.

tocs.author: Christian Presley
tocs.notes: For developers: keeps a record of Lua errors, blocked actions and recent events, to read after /reload.

tocs.title: Forever Gather
tocs.author: Christian Presley
tocs.notes: Remembers where you gather herbs, ore, fish, treasure and quest objects, and shows those places on the world map and the minimap.

tocs.title: Forever Compass
tocs.author: Christian Presley
tocs.notes: A compass bar at the top of the screen that scrolls as you turn. Up to four trackers mark the nearest quest giver, quest objective, turn-in, rare enemy, vendor, flight master and more on it.

tocs.title: Forever Auctions
tocs.author: Christian Presley
tocs.notes: Remembers auction house prices, scans all listings, finds deals, keeps a shopping list, price alerts and a ledger of your sales and purchases, helps you price your auctions and shows prices in item tooltips.

tocs.title: Forever Leveling
tocs.author: Christian Presley
tocs.notes: Your experience at a glance: XP an hour, time to level, kills and quests to level, rested XP, and the zones that suit your level.

tocs.title: Forever Probe

toc.title: Cooldown Manager Utils by |cff55d2ffD4KiR |T132115:16:16:0:0|t
toc.author: D4KiR
toc.notes: Adds a Buff Reminders tab to the Cooldown Manager and shows icons for tracked buffs you are missing.

localizedNotes.deDE: Ergänzt den Cooldown-Manager um einen Tab für Buff-Erinnerungen und zeigt Symbole für verfolgte Buffs, die dir fehlen.
localizedNotes.esES: Añade una pestaña de recordatorios de beneficios al gestor de tiempos de reutilización y muestra iconos de los beneficios seguidos que te faltan.
localizedNotes.esMX: Agrega una pestaña de recordatorios de beneficios al administrador de tiempos de reutilización y muestra íconos de los beneficios seguidos que te faltan.
localizedNotes.frFR: Ajoute un onglet de rappels d'améliorations au gestionnaire de temps de recharge et affiche les icônes des améliorations suivies qui vous manquent.
localizedNotes.itIT: Aggiunge una scheda di promemoria dei benefici al gestore dei tempi di recupero e mostra le icone dei benefici monitorati che ti mancano.
localizedNotes.koKR: 재사용 대기시간 관리자에 버프 알림 탭을 추가하고 추적 중인 버프가 없을 때 아이콘으로 표시합니다.
localizedNotes.ptBR: Adiciona uma aba de lembretes de bônus ao gerenciador de recargas e mostra ícones dos bônus rastreados que estão faltando.
localizedNotes.ruRU: Добавляет в менеджер восстановления вкладку напоминаний о баффах и показывает значки отслеживаемых баффов, которых у вас нет.
localizedNotes.zhCN: 为冷却管理器添加增益提醒标签页，并以图标显示你缺少的已追踪增益。
localizedNotes.zhTW: 為冷卻管理器新增增益提醒分頁，並以圖示顯示你缺少的已追蹤增益。

candidates.description: One click to buff back whoever just buffed you and nearby players missing yours, and it keeps your own buffs up too: armors, auras, aspects, poisons, food and more. For WoW Forever, Classic, TBC, Mists and retail.

toc.title: Manners
toc.author: Sacha
toc.notes: Somebody buffed you. One click buffs them back, and your target is handed straight back.

localizedNotes.deDE: Jemand hat Euch gestärkt. Ein Klick erwidert den Gefallen, und Euer Ziel bekommt Ihr gleich zurück.
localizedNotes.esES: Alguien te ha dado un beneficio. Un clic se lo devuelve, y tu objetivo anterior vuelve enseguida.

localizedNotes.frFR: Quelqu'un vient de vous buffer. Un clic pour lui rendre la politesse, et votre cible vous est aussitôt rendue.
localizedNotes.itIT: Qualcuno ti ha appena dato un beneficio. Un clic per ricambiare, e il tuo bersaglio ti viene subito restituito.
localizedNotes.koKR: 누군가 나에게 버프를 주면 클릭 한 번으로 보답하고, 내 대상도 곧바로 돌려받습니다.
localizedNotes.ptBR: Alguém acabou de dar um bônus a você. Um clique devolve o favor, e o seu alvo anterior volta na hora.
localizedNotes.zhCN: 有人给你加了增益，一键回敬对方，你原来的目标也会马上恢复。
localizedNotes.zhTW: 有人替你加了增益，一鍵回敬對方，你原本的目標也會馬上恢復。

tocs.author: Huguillo
tocs.notes: Busca cualquier objeto del juego por su nombre (equipo, materiales, consumibles, objetos de misión, recetas, monturas, mascotas…) y dice cómo se consigue (botín con porcentaje, misión, vendedor, fabricación), de qué tipo es y qué nivel pide; con filtros de clase, especialización, hueco y nivel enseñ…

tocs.title: Partir montones
tocs.author: Huguillo
tocs.notes: Mayús + clic izquierdo en un montón de las bolsas abre siempre la ventanita para partirlo (elegir cuántos coger), también con Baganator. Si el objeto no se apila, lo avisa. Con el comercio abierto, la parte que eliges va sola al comercio (el juego, si no, daría el montón entero).

tocs.title: Panel de objetivos plegado
tocs.author: Huguillo
tocs.notes: Deja plegado el panel de objetivos al entrar y al recargar, y lo vuelve a plegar si el juego lo despliega solo; si lo despliegas tú, se queda así hasta la próxima carga. (Hasta la 1.0 traía también un botón «Limpiar misiones»: se quitó porque Polestar ya lo hace con su ventana «Haz sitio en tu regis…

tocs.title: Un aviso por partida
tocs.author: Huguillo
tocs.notes: Los avisos de «hay una versión nueva» de Polestar, GearQuest, OpenMap y Dungeon Journal salen una sola vez cada vez que abres el juego, no en cada recarga de la interfaz.

tocs.title: Subasta: escaneo automático
tocs.author: Huguillo
tocs.notes: Deja siempre encendida la opción de Auctionator «Ejecutar escaneo automático al abrir la casa de subastas», para que el registro de precios se actualice solo.

tocs.title: Polestar: probabilidad real
tocs.author: Huguillo
tocs.notes: Pone en Polestar la probabilidad real de que cada enemigo suelte un objeto de misión (lo que miden en Forever los jugadores de EG Link y lo que te cae a ti, siempre con la misión cogida) y rellena la que Polestar no tiene. También la enseña al pasar el ratón por el enemigo.

toc.title: Wanderer Campfire Game
toc.author: Jaekco
toc.notes: A little idle game in a Wanderer window: your campfire grows, companions set out on expeditions across Azeroth, and your real journey (zones explored, professions, level) makes it stronger.

localizedNotes.deDE: Ein kleines Idle-Spiel in einem Wanderer-Fenster: dein Lagerfeuer wächst, Gefährten ziehen auf Expeditionen durch Azeroth, und deine echte Reise (erkundete Gebiete, Berufe, Stufe) macht es stärker.

localizedNotes.itIT: Un piccolo gioco idle in una finestra di Wanderer: il tuo fuoco da campo cresce, i compagni partono in spedizione per Azeroth e il tuo vero viaggio (zone esplorate, professioni, livello) lo rafforza.

localizedNotes.zhCN: Wanderer 窗口中的小型放置游戏：篝火不断壮大，同伴们踏上穿越艾泽拉斯的远征，而你真实的旅程（探索的区域、专业、等级）让营地更强大。

toc.title: Wanderer Chat
toc.author: Jaekco
toc.notes: The chat made calm: a glass look that fades, your name in gold, a card when you are named or greeted, quieter public channels, tabs with counts, private messages in their window.

localizedNotes.deDE: Ein ruhiger Chat: ein gläserner Look, der verblasst, dein Name in Gold, eine Karte, wenn man dich nennt oder grüßt, ruhigere öffentliche Kanäle, Reiter mit Zählern, private Nachrichten in ihrem Fenster.
localizedNotes.esES: Un chat sereno: un aspecto de cristal que se desvanece, tu nombre en dorado, una tarjeta cuando te nombran o te saludan, canales públicos más tranquilos, pestañas con contadores, los mensajes privados en su ventana.
localizedNotes.esMX: Un chat sereno: un aspecto de cristal que se desvanece, tu nombre en dorado, una tarjeta cuando te nombran o te saludan, canales públicos más tranquilos, pestañas con contadores, los mensajes privados en su ventana.
localizedNotes.frFR: Un chat apaisé : un aspect de verre qui s'efface, votre nom en or, une carte quand on vous nomme ou vous salue, des canaux publics plus calmes, des onglets avec leurs compteurs, les messages privés dans leur fenêtre.
localizedNotes.itIT: Una chat serena: un aspetto di vetro che svanisce, il tuo nome in oro, un riquadro quando ti nominano o ti salutano, canali pubblici più tranquilli, schede con i contatori, i messaggi privati nella loro finestra.
localizedNotes.koKR: 차분한 채팅: 서서히 사라지는 유리 같은 모습, 금색으로 표시되는 내 이름, 누가 나를 부르거나 인사할 때 나타나는 카드, 더 조용한 공개 채널, 개수가 표시되는 탭, 전용 창의 귓속말.
localizedNotes.ptBR: Um chat tranquilo: um visual de vidro que se apaga, seu nome em dourado, um cartão quando citam seu nome ou te cumprimentam, canais públicos mais calmos, abas com contadores, as mensagens privadas na janela delas.
localizedNotes.ruRU: Спокойный чат: стеклянный вид, который тает, ваше имя золотом, карточка, когда вас называют или приветствуют, более тихие общие каналы, вкладки со счётчиками, личные сообщения в своём окне.
localizedNotes.zhCN: 安静的聊天：会渐渐淡去的玻璃外观，金色显示的你的名字，有人提到你或打招呼时出现的卡片，更清静的公共频道，带计数的标签页，私聊在专属窗口中。
localizedNotes.zhTW: 安靜的聊天：會漸漸淡去的玻璃外觀，金色顯示的你的名字，有人提到你或打招呼時出現的卡片，更清靜的公共頻道，帶計數的分頁，私聊在專屬視窗中。

localizedNotes.zhCN: 一个安静直观的专业技能工作台：每个配方都带图标，材料以卡片显示，还有接下来值得制作的物品和一个队列。

toc.title: Wanderer Training
toc.author: Jaekco
toc.notes: What your trainers have for you, in a window of its own (a button on your spellbook): class spells, weapon skills, demon tomes, and what they will cost now, at the next level and up to the last.

localizedNotes.deDE: Was deine Lehrer für dich haben, in einem eigenen Fenster (ein Knopf an deinem Zauberbuch): Klassenzauber, Waffenfertigkeiten, Dämonenfolianten, und was sie jetzt, auf der nächsten Stufe und bis zur letzten kosten.
localizedNotes.esES: Lo que tus instructores tienen para ti, en su propia ventana (un botón en tu libro de hechizos): hechizos de clase, habilidades de armas, tomos de demonio, y lo que costarán ahora, en el próximo nivel y hasta el último.
localizedNotes.esMX: Lo que tus instructores tienen para ti, en su propia ventana (un botón en tu libro de hechizos): hechizos de clase, habilidades de armas, tomos de demonio, y lo que costarán ahora, en el próximo nivel y hasta el último.
localizedNotes.frFR: Ce que vos maîtres vous réservent, dans sa propre fenêtre (un bouton sur votre grimoire) : sorts de classe, compétences d'armes, grimoires de démon, et ce qu'ils coûteront maintenant, au prochain niveau et jusqu'au dernier.
localizedNotes.itIT: Ciò che i tuoi istruttori hanno per te, in una finestra tutta sua (un pulsante sul tuo libro degli incantesimi): incantesimi di classe, abilità con le armi, tomi demoniaci, e quanto costeranno ora, al prossimo livello e fino all'ultimo.
localizedNotes.koKR: 숙련가가 가르쳐 줄 것을 전용 창에서 (주문서의 버튼): 직업 주문, 무기 숙련, 악마 마법서, 그리고 지금, 다음 레벨, 마지막 레벨까지의 비용.
localizedNotes.ptBR: O que seus instrutores têm para você, numa janela própria (um botão no seu grimório): feitiços de classe, perícias com armas, tomos demoníacos, e quanto vão custar agora, no próximo nível e até o último.
localizedNotes.ruRU: Чему вас научат наставники, в отдельном окне (кнопка на книге заклинаний): заклинания класса, навыки владения оружием, фолианты демонов и сколько они будут стоить сейчас, на следующем уровне и до последнего.
localizedNotes.zhCN: 在独立窗口中查看训练师能教你什么（法术书上有一个按钮）：职业法术、武器技能、恶魔典籍，以及现在、下一级和直到最后一级的费用。
localizedNotes.zhTW: 在獨立視窗中查看訓練師能教你什麼（法術書上有一個按鈕）：職業法術、武器技能、惡魔典籍，以及現在、下一級和直到最後一級的費用。

tocs.title: BuffCheck: Party Buffs at a Glance
tocs.author: jwang47
tocs.notes: Your buffs and your group's at a glance: green on, yellow ending, red missing. Click a row to buff that person; the Next line (with a key) buffs whoever needs it. A ready check when you leave town. /buffs

tocs.title: LootValue: Sell, Vendor or Disenchant
tocs.author: jwang47
tocs.notes: Requires Auctionator. Tooltip advice from its prices: sell on the AH, disenchant or vendor, and how hard the AH sale looks; how well your own auctions of it sold and what sells, from full scans. Auto-loot that leaves cheap junk (/lv). Clear your bags: sell, disenchant and auction lists (/lv clear).

tocs.title: Workbench: Crafting Profit and Skill-ups
tocs.author: jwang47
tocs.notes: One window for your professions: every recipe by profit, and the cheapest next skill point. Needs UpgradeFinder (it reads the recipes and prices). /wb

tocs.title: QuestBoard: Best Quests Now
tocs.author: jwang47
tocs.notes: The quests that matter now: ready to turn in, nearest objectives, and quests to pick up that fit your level, by XP per minute. /qb

tocs.title: UpgradeFinder: Gear Upgrades
tocs.author: jwang47
tocs.notes: Gear from your Auctionator scan, your bags and the dungeon drops that beats what you wear, for your class. /uf or the Upgrades button on the Auction House.

tocs.title: MGA Waypoints
tocs.author: MyGamingAssistant

tocs.title: MGA Professions
tocs.author: MyGamingAssistant
tocs.notes: The site's profession guides in game: your leveling route from your current skill, the mats you have and need, trainers for your next rank and where to gather.

tocs.title: MGA Dungeon Quests

tocs.notes: A dungeon journal for WoW Forever: every dungeon, its bosses and loot, and every quest to pick up for it, ticked with the quests you've done, and map pins plus a route for the quests you're ready to turn in, inside a dungeon it tracks only that dungeon's quests and says what's left before you leave,…

toc.author: ljk5000

toc.title: Mnemosyne
toc.author: Llyth
toc.notes: Recognize the players you know behind their WoW Forever characters: the nickname they go by, on their tooltip and in chat. See the professions and recipes of your guild and friends.

localizedNotes.deDE: Erkennt die Spieler, die Ihr kennt, hinter ihren WoW-Forever-Charakteren: den Spitznamen, unter dem sie bekannt sind, in ihrem Tooltip und im Chat. Seht die Berufe und Rezepte Eurer Gilde und Eurer Freunde.
localizedNotes.esES: Reconoce a los jugadores que conoces tras sus personajes de WoW Forever: el apodo que usan, en su descripción y en el chat. Consulta las profesiones y recetas de tu hermandad y tus amigos.
localizedNotes.esMX: Reconoce a los jugadores que conoces detrás de sus personajes de WoW Forever: el apodo con el que se les conoce, en su descripción emergente y en el chat. Consulta las profesiones y recetas de tu hermandad y tus amigos.
localizedNotes.frFR: Reconnaissez les joueurs que vous connaissez derrière leurs personnages de WoW Forever : le pseudonyme sous lequel ils jouent, dans leur infobulle et dans la discussion. Consultez les métiers et les recettes de votre guilde et de vos amis.
localizedNotes.koKR: WoW Forever 캐릭터 뒤에 있는 아는 플레이어를 알아보세요: 그 플레이어의 별명을 툴팁과 대화창에 표시합니다. 길드원과 친구의 전문 기술과 제조법도 확인하세요.
localizedNotes.ptBR: Reconheça os jogadores que você conhece por trás dos personagens de WoW Forever: o apelido que eles usam, na dica de interface e no bate-papo. Veja as profissões e receitas da sua guilda e dos seus amigos.
localizedNotes.ruRU: Узнавайте знакомых игроков за их персонажами в WoW Forever: прозвище, под которым их знают, в подсказке и в чате. Смотрите профессии и рецепты вашей гильдии и друзей.
localizedNotes.zhCN: 在WoW Forever中认出你认识的玩家，无论他们用哪个角色：在鼠标提示和聊天中显示他们的昵称。还可以查看公会成员和好友的专业和配方。
localizedNotes.zhTW: 在WoW Forever角色背後認出你認識的玩家：在他們的滑鼠提示和聊天中顯示他們使用的暱稱。還可以查看公會成員和好友的專業技能和配方。

candidates.description: A simple Bagnon plugin designating items and recipes for which the required character or skill level is not yet fulfilled.

toc.title: Bagnon RequiredLevel
toc.author: LudiusMaximus
toc.notes: A simple Bagnon plugin that displays items and recipes in red for which the required character or skill level is not yet fulfilled. The required level is then displayed in the corner.|n(Based on "Bagnon ItemLevel" by Lars "Goldpaw" Norberg.)

localizedNotes.deDE: Ein einfaches Bagnon-Plugin, das Gegenstände und Rezepte in Rot anzeigt, für die die benötigte Charakter- oder Fertigkeitsstufe noch nicht erreicht ist. Die benötigte Stufe wird dann in der Ecke angezeigt.|n(Basierend auf „Bagnon ItemLevel“ von Lars „Goldpaw“ Norberg.)
localizedNotes.esES: Un sencillo plugin de Bagnon que muestra objetos y recetas en rojo para los cuales el nivel de personaje o de habilidad requerido aún no se ha alcanzado. El nivel requerido se muestra en la esquina.|n(Basado en "Bagnon ItemLevel" de Lars "Goldpaw" Norberg.)
localizedNotes.esMX: Un sencillo plugin de Bagnon que muestra objetos y recetas en rojo para los cuales el nivel de personaje o de habilidad requerido aún no se ha alcanzado. El nivel requerido se muestra en la esquina.|n(Basado en "Bagnon ItemLevel" de Lars "Goldpaw" Norberg.)
localizedNotes.frFR: Un simple plugin Bagnon qui affiche les objets et recettes en rouge pour lesquels le niveau de personnage ou de compétence requis n'est pas encore atteint. Le niveau requis est alors affiché dans le coin.|n(Basé sur "Bagnon ItemLevel" de Lars "Goldpaw" Norberg.)
localizedNotes.itIT: Un semplice plugin per Bagnon che mostra oggetti e ricette in rosso per i quali il livello del personaggio o dell'abilità richiesto non è ancora stato raggiunto. Il livello richiesto viene poi mostrato nell'angolo.|n(Basato su "Bagnon ItemLevel" di Lars "Goldpaw" Norberg.)
localizedNotes.koKR: 간단한 Bagnon 플러그인으로, 요구되는 캐릭터 또는 기술 레벨을 아직 달성하지 못한 아이템과 레시피를 빨간색으로 표시합니다. 요구 레벨은 모서리에 표시됩니다.|n(Lars "Goldpaw" Norberg의 "Bagnon ItemLevel" 기반.)
localizedNotes.ptBR: Um plugin simples do Bagnon que exibe itens e receitas em vermelho para os quais o nível de personagem ou habilidade necessário ainda não foi alcançado. O nível necessário é então exibido no canto.|n(Baseado em "Bagnon ItemLevel" de Lars "Goldpaw" Norberg.)
localizedNotes.ruRU: Простой плагин для Bagnon, который отображает предметы и рецепты красным цветом, если требуемый уровень персонажа или навыка еще не достигнут. Требуемый уровень затем отображается в углу.|n(Основано на «Bagnon ItemLevel» от Lars «Goldpaw» Norberg.)
localizedNotes.zhCN: 一个简单的 Bagnon 插件，如果所需的角色或技能等级尚未达到，物品和配方将以红色显示。所需的等级会显示在角落。|n（基于 Lars "Goldpaw" Norberg 的 "Bagnon ItemLevel"。）
localizedNotes.zhTW: 一個簡單的 Bagnon 插件，如果所需的角色或技能等級尚未達到，物品和配方將以紅色顯示。所需的等級會顯示在角落。|n（基於 Lars "Goldpaw" Norberg 的 "Bagnon ItemLevel"。）

Switch it on or off in MelloUI (/mello); untick it here to not load it at all.

tocs.title: |cff9b8cffMello|rUI Frame Effects

Switch them on or off in MelloUI (/mello); untick it here to not…

tocs.title: BuffDrop
tocs.author: Pietjan
tocs.notes: In combat, a pulsing grey icon the moment a buff you keep up on yourself falls off: Battle Shout, shaman shields, seals, Slice and Dice, Inner Fire, armors, Thorns, aspects. /buffdrop to move it.

tocs.title: LootFeed
tocs.author: Pietjan
tocs.notes: A short list of what you just picked up: items with how many you now carry, money, reputation, experience and honor, and what your group loots. Each line fades after a few seconds. /lootfeed

tocs.title: PetAuras
tocs.author: Pietjan
tocs.notes: Your pet's buffs and debuffs as small icons under the pet frame, drawn by the game's own aura buttons.

tocs.title: BulkInbox
tocs.author: Pietjan
tocs.notes: A list beside the inbox of every item and sum of money in your mail: take all, the money, or the rows you mark. One take at a time, C.O.D. never paid, stops cleanly on full bags. /bulkinbox

tocs.title: FishClick
tocs.author: Pietjan
tocs.notes: With a fishing pole equipped, double-click into the world to cast your line. /fish

tocs.title: LootRolls
tocs.author: Pietjan
tocs.notes: Movable group loot roll bars in the XLoot layout: icon, timer bar with the item name, Need/Greed/Pass with how many chose each and who (hover). /lootrolls

tocs.title: TrackSwap
tocs.author: Pietjan
tocs.notes: Alternates minimap tracking between Find Herbs and Find Minerals every few seconds, so both kinds of node show up. /ts

tocs.title: CompactTip
tocs.author: Pietjan
tocs.notes: Unit tooltips you can read at a glance: one line per quest objective naming only who still needs it, names in class colour, and item and spell IDs while Alt is held.

tocs.title: HealerMana
tocs.author: Pietjan
tocs.notes: The mana of your group's healers as a column of rows: class icon, name, percentage (or dead or offline), and an icon while drinking, innervated or soulstoned. /healermana to move it.

tocs.title: SellAdvice
tocs.author: Pietjan
tocs.notes: One line in item tooltips: disenchant, smelt, vendor or auction, whichever brings the most, from Auctionator's scanned prices. A gold coin marks the quest choice worth the most. With full bags, a red cross in Baganator marks the item cheapest to drop. Hold Alt for the workings. /sell lists everythin…

tocs.title: CooldownNag
tocs.author: Pietjan
tocs.notes: An icon pops up a few seconds before an ability you chose comes off cooldown, and stays a moment once it is ready. Configured from a tab in the Cooldown Manager's settings. /cdn

localizedNotes.nlNL: |cFF33CCFFAvonturengids voor WoW Forever: kerkerquests en reeksen, bazen en buit, kerkerkaarten, raids, evenementquests en reputaties.|r
localizedNotes.noNO: |cFF33CCFFEventyrguide for WoW Forever: dungeon-oppdrag og kjeder, bosser og bytte, dungeonkart, raid, oppdrag fra hendelser og omdømme.|r
localizedNotes.plPL: |cFF33CCFFPrzewodnik przygód po WoW Forever: zadania i łańcuchy lochów, bossowie i łupy, mapy lochów, rajdy, zadania wydarzeń i reputacje.|r
localizedNotes.ptBR: |cFF33CCFFGuia de aventura para o WoW Forever: missões de masmorra e cadeias, chefes e saque, mapas de masmorra, raides, missões de eventos e reputações.|r
localizedNotes.roRO: |cFF33CCFFGhid de aventură pentru WoW Forever: misiuni și lanțuri din temnițe, boși și pradă, hărți de temniță, raiduri, misiuni de evenimente și reputații.|r
localizedNotes.ruRU: |cFF33CCFFПутеводитель по WoW Forever: задания и цепочки подземелий, боссы и добыча, карты подземелий, рейды, задания праздников и репутации.|r
localizedNotes.skSK: |cFF33CCFFSprievodca dobrodružstvom pre WoW Forever: úlohy a reťazce z dungeonov, bossovia a korisť, mapy dungeonov, raidy, úlohy udalostí a reputácie.|r
localizedNotes.slSI: |cFF33CCFFVodnik po pustolovščinah za WoW Forever: naloge in verige ječ, šefi in plen, zemljevidi ječ, raidi, naloge dogodkov in ugled.|r
localizedNotes.srRS: |cFF33CCFFVodič kroz avanture za WoW Forever: zadaci i lanci tamnica, šefovi i plen, mape tamnica, raidovi, zadaci događaja i ugled.|r
localizedNotes.svSE: |cFF33CCFFÄventyrsguide för WoW Forever: dungeon-uppdrag och kedjor, bossar och byte, dungeonkartor, räder, evenemangsuppdrag och rykte.|r
localizedNotes.taIN: |cFF33CCFFWoW Forever சாகச வழிகாட்டி: நிலவறை பணிகள் மற்றும் தொடர்கள், தலைவர்கள் மற்றும் கொள்ளை, நிலவறை வரைபடங்கள், ரெய்டுகள், நிகழ்வு பணிகள், நற்பெயர்.|r
localizedNotes.teIN: |cFF33CCFFWoW Forever సాహస గైడ్: డంజన్ క్వెస్ట్‌లు మరియు గొలుసులు, బాస్‌లు మరియు లూట్, డంజన్ మ్యాప్‌లు, రైడ్‌లు, ఈవెంట్ క్వెస్ట్‌లు మరియు ప్రతిష్ఠ.|r
localizedNotes.thTH: |cFF33CCFFคู่มือการผจญภัยสำหรับ WoW Forever: เควสและสายเควสดันเจี้ยน บอสและของดรอป แผนที่ดันเจี้ยน เรด เควสเทศกาล และชื่อเสียง|r
localizedNotes.trTR: |cFF33CCFFWoW Forever macera rehberi: zindan görevleri ve zincirleri, bosslar ve ganimet, zindan haritaları, baskınlar, etkinlik görevleri ve itibarlar.|r
localizedNotes.ukUA: |cFF33CCFFПутівник пригод для WoW Forever: завдання та ланцюжки підземель, боси та здобич, мапи підземель, рейди, завдання свят і репутації.|r
localizedNotes.urPK: |cFF33CCFFWoW Forever کی ایڈونچر گائیڈ: ڈنجن کوئسٹس اور سلسلے، باس اور لوٹ، ڈنجن نقشے، ریڈز، تہواروں کے کوئسٹس اور ساکھ۔|r
localizedNotes.viVN: |cFF33CCFFCẩm nang phiêu lưu cho WoW Forever: nhiệm vụ và chuỗi hầm ngục, trùm và vật phẩm rơi, bản đồ hầm ngục, đột kích, nhiệm vụ sự kiện và danh vọng.|r
localizedNotes.zhCN: |cFF33CCFFWoW Forever 冒险指南：地下城任务与任务链、首领与掉落、地下城地图、团队副本、节日任务和声望。|r
localizedNotes.zhTW: |cFF33CCFFWoW Forever 冒險指南：地城任務與任務鏈、首領與掉落、地城地圖、團隊副本、節慶任務和聲望。|r

tocs.title: |cffebad33SentiUI|r Settings
tocs.author: xRL-Dev.de
tocs.notes: Settings core for the SentiUI suite. SentiUI_* addons dock their own option pages into the window.

localizedNotes.deDE: Einstellungs-Kern fuer das SentiUI-Interface. SentiUI_*-Addons docken ihre eigenen Optionen an.

tocs.title: |cffebad33SentiUI|r Bags
tocs.author: xRL-Dev.de
tocs.notes: The bags module for SentiUI: one clean bag window and a bank window with categories, search, sorting, a currency strip, auto sell of grey items and auto repair.

localizedNotes.deDE: Das Taschen-Modul für SentiUI: ein übersichtliches Taschen- und Bankfenster mit Kategorien, Suche, Sortieren, Währungsleiste, Auto-Verkauf grauer Items und Auto-Reparatur.

tocs.title: |cffebad33SentiUI|r Chat
tocs.author: xRL-Dev.de
tocs.notes: The chat module for SentiUI: Sentinel-styled panels, tabs, edit box and message filter.

localizedNotes.deDE: Das Chat-Modul für SentiUI: Sentinel-Panels, Tabs, Eingabezeile und Nachrichtenfilter.

tocs.title: |cffebad33SentiUI|r Loot
tocs.author: xRL-Dev.de
tocs.notes: The loot module for SentiUI: fast looting, chat loot filter, loot log and styled loot/roll windows.

localizedNotes.deDE: Das Beute-Modul für SentiUI: schnelles Plündern, Chat-Filter, Beute-Log und angepasste Beute-/Würfelfenster.

tocs.title: |cffebad33SentiUI|r Buffs
tocs.author: xRL-Dev.de
tocs.notes: The buffs module for SentiUI: the client's own buff, debuff and weapon-enchant frames with the Sentinel look, on movable anchors.

localizedNotes.deDE: Das Buffs-Modul für SentiUI: die eigenen Buff-, Debuff- und Waffenverzauberungs-Fenster des Clients im Sentinel-Look auf beweglichen Ankern.

tocs.title: |cffebad33SentiUI|r Professions
tocs.author: xRL-Dev.de
tocs.notes: A SentiUI professions window: recipe list with search and filters, difficulty colors, materials with owned counts, a create footer with amounts - the game's own window stays parked under it for NPC and guild lists.

localizedNotes.deDE: Ein SentiUI-Berufsfenster: Rezeptliste mit Suche und Filtern, Schwierigkeitsfarben, Materialien mit Bestand, ein Herstellen-Fussbereich mit Mengen - das Spiel-Fenster bleibt darunter geparkt für NPC- und Gilden-Listen.

tocs.title: |cffebad33SentiUI|r Meters
tocs.author: xRL-Dev.de
tocs.notes: Dockable meter panels for SentiUI: up to two small windows next to the loot chat, each showing a different metric (damage, DPS, healing, threat and more) from the client's own damage meter data.

localizedNotes.deDE: Andockbare Meter-Panels für SentiUI: bis zu zwei kleine Fenster neben dem Plündern-Chat, jedes zeigt eine eigene Metrik (Schaden, DPS, Heilung, Bedrohung und mehr) aus den Schadensmeter-Daten des Clients.

tocs.title: |cffebad33SentiUI|r Quests
tocs.author: xRL-Dev.de
tocs.notes: The quest tracker module for SentiUI: own Sentinel tracker or Questie's tracker.

localizedNotes.deDE: Das Quest-Modul für SentiUI: eigene Sentinel-Questverfolgung oder die von Questie.

tocs.title: |cffebad33SentiUI|r BugSack
tocs.author: xRL-Dev.de
tocs.notes: The error grabber for SentiUI: captures Lua errors and forbidden calls, groups them by addon and shows them in a copyable BugSack-style window.

localizedNotes.deDE: Der Fehlersammler für SentiUI: fängt Lua-Fehler und verbotene Aufrufe ab, gruppiert sie nach Addon und zeigt sie in einem kopierbaren BugSack-Fenster.

tocs.title: |cffebad33SentiUI|r Minimap
tocs.author: xRL-Dev.de
tocs.notes: The minimap module for SentiUI: shape, scale, border and element visibility.

localizedNotes.deDE: Das Minimap-Modul für SentiUI: Form, Skalierung, Rahmen und sichtbare Elemente.

tocs.title: |cffebad33SentiUI|r Tooltips

toc.title: SMoRG's QoL
toc.author: SMoRG75
toc.notes: Hear your quest progress: a worker voice line when you complete a quest objective, and another when the whole quest is done (Horde Peon or Alliance worker). Plus toggleable quality-of-life tweaks: a quest radar above nameplates, a session recap, colored quest progress, quest auto-tracking, quest automation, a range icon and distance, tooltip targets and colors, item level and movement speed, XP/reputation colors, party levels, reputation watching that returns to your preferred faction, cursor highlight, Wowhead links, and ready check/queue countdowns. Options window via LDB, the addon compartment or /sqol config. Also runs in Classic Era, Anniversary and Mists of Pandaria Classic.

localizedNotes.deDE: Höre deinen Questfortschritt: eine Arbeiter-Sprachzeile, wenn du ein Questziel erfüllst, und eine weitere, wenn die ganze Quest abgeschlossen ist (Horde-Peon: "Work, work." / "Work complete." oder Allianz-Arbeiter: "More work?" / "Job's done!"). Dazu abschaltbare Komfortfunktionen: Questradar über Namensplaketten, Abenteuer-Rückblick, farbiger Questfortschritt, automatisches Verfolgen, Annehmen und Abgeben von Quests, Reichweitensymbol und Entfernung, Ziel und Farben im Tooltip, Gegenstandsstufe und Bewegungstempo, EP-/Ruffarben, Gruppenstufen, Rufbeobachtung mit Rückkehr zum bevorzugten Ruf, Cursor-Hervorhebung, Wowhead-Links sowie Countdowns für Bereitschaftscheck und Warteschlange. Optionen über LDB, das Addon-Menü an der Minikarte oder /sqol config. Läuft auch in Classic Era, Anniversary und Mists of Pandaria Classic.
localizedNotes.esES: Escucha el progreso de tus misiones: una frase de trabajador al completar un objetivo de misión y otra cuando la misión entera está terminada (peón de la Horda: "Work, work." / "Work complete." o trabajador de la Alianza: "More work?" / "Job's done!"). Además, mejoras opcionales: radar de misiones sobre las placas de nombre, resumen de aventuras, progreso de misión en color, seguimiento y automatización de misiones, icono y distancia de alcance, objetivo y colores en las descripciones emergentes, nivel de objeto y velocidad de movimiento, colores de experiencia y reputación, niveles del grupo, seguimiento de reputación con vuelta a la reputación preferida, resaltado del cursor, enlaces de Wowhead y cuentas atrás para la comprobación de preparados y las colas. Ventana de opciones mediante LDB, el menú de addons o /sqol config. También funciona en Classic Era, Anniversary y Mists of Pandaria Classic.
localizedNotes.esMX: Escucha el progreso de tus misiones: una frase de trabajador al completar un objetivo de misión y otra cuando la misión entera está terminada (peón de la Horda: "Work, work." / "Work complete." o trabajador de la Alianza: "More work?" / "Job's done!"). Además, mejoras opcionales: radar de misiones sobre las placas de nombre, resumen de aventuras, progreso de misión en color, seguimiento y automatización de misiones, ícono y distancia de alcance, objetivo y colores en las descripciones emergentes, nivel de objeto y velocidad de movimiento, colores de experiencia y reputación, niveles del grupo, seguimiento de reputación con vuelta a la reputación preferida, resaltado del cursor, enlaces de Wowhead y cuentas regresivas para la verificación de listos y las colas. Ventana de opciones mediante LDB, el menú de addons o /sqol config. También funciona en Classic Era, Anniversary y Mists of Pandaria Classic.
localizedNotes.frFR: Entendez votre progression de quête : une réplique d'ouvrier quand vous accomplissez un objectif de quête, et une autre quand la quête entière est terminée (péon de la Horde : "Work, work." / "Work complete." ou ouvrier de l'Alliance : "More work?" / "Job's done!"). Plus des améliorations activables : radar de quêtes au-dessus des barres d'info, bilan d'aventure, progression de quête en couleur, suivi et automatisation des quêtes, icône et distance de portée, cible et couleurs dans les infobulles, niveau d'objet et vitesse de déplacement, couleurs d'XP et de réputation, niveaux du groupe, suivi de réputation avec retour à la réputation préférée, surbrillance du curseur, liens Wowhead et comptes à rebours pour l'appel et la file d'attente. Fenêtre d'options via LDB, le menu des addons ou /sqol config. Fonctionne aussi sur Classic Era, Anniversary et Mists of Pandaria Classic.
localizedNotes.itIT: Ascolta i progressi delle tue missioni: una battuta del lavoratore quando completi un obiettivo e un'altra quando l'intera missione è conclusa (peone dell'Orda: "Work, work." / "Work complete." o lavoratore dell'Alleanza: "More work?" / "Job's done!"). In più, migliorie attivabili: radar missioni sopra le barre delle unità, riepilogo avventura, progressi delle missioni colorati, tracciamento e automazione delle missioni, icona e distanza di portata, bersaglio e colori nei tooltip, livello oggetto e velocità di movimento, colori di PE e reputazione, livelli del gruppo, monitoraggio della reputazione con ritorno a quella preferita, evidenziazione del cursore, link di Wowhead e conti alla rovescia per appello e coda. Finestra delle opzioni tramite LDB, il menu degli addon o /sqol config. Funziona anche in Classic Era, Anniversary e Mists of Pandaria Classic.
localizedNotes.koKR: 퀘스트 진행을 소리로 들으세요: 퀘스트 목표를 완료하면 일꾼 대사가, 퀘스트 전체를 완료하면 또 다른 대사가 재생됩니다 (호드 일꾼: "Work, work." / "Work complete." 또는 얼라이언스 일꾼: "More work?" / "Job's done!"). 그 밖에 켜고 끌 수 있는 편의 기능: 이름표 위 퀘스트 레이더, 모험 요약, 퀘스트 진행 색상, 퀘스트 자동 추적 및 자동화, 사거리 아이콘과 거리, 툴팁 대상 표시 및 색상, 아이템 레벨과 이동 속도, 경험치/평판 색상, 파티원 레벨, 선호 평판으로 돌아가는 평판 추적, 커서 강조, Wowhead 링크, 전투 준비 확인/대기열 카운트다운. LDB, 애드온 메뉴 또는 /sqol config로 설정 창을 엽니다. Classic Era, Anniversary, Mists of Pandaria Classic에서도 작동합니다.
localizedNotes.ptBR: Ouça o progresso das suas missões: uma fala de trabalhador ao concluir um objetivo de missão e outra quando a missão inteira estiver concluída (peão da Horda: "Work, work." / "Work complete." ou trabalhador da Aliança: "More work?" / "Job's done!"). Além disso, ajustes opcionais: radar de missões acima das placas de identificação, resumo da aventura, progresso de missão colorido, rastreamento e automação de missões, ícone e distância de alcance, alvo e cores nas dicas de tela, nível de item e velocidade de movimento, cores de XP e reputação, níveis do grupo, acompanhamento de reputação com volta à reputação preferida, destaque do cursor, links do Wowhead e contagens regressivas de verificação de prontidão e de fila. Janela de opções via LDB, o menu de addons ou /sqol config. Também funciona no Classic Era, Anniversary e Mists of Pandaria Classic.
localizedNotes.ruRU: Озвучка прогресса заданий: реплика рабочего при выполнении цели задания и ещё одна, когда задание выполнено полностью (пеон Орды: "Work, work." / "Work complete." или рабочий Альянса: "More work?" / "Job's done!"). А также отключаемые улучшения: радар заданий над индикаторами здоровья, итоги приключения, цветной прогресс заданий, автоотслеживание и автоматизация заданий, значок и расстояние дальности, цель и цвета во всплывающих подсказках, уровень предметов и скорость передвижения, цвета опыта и репутации, уровни группы, отслеживание репутации с возвратом к выбранной фракции, подсветка курсора, ссылки Wowhead и таймеры проверки готовности и очереди. Окно настроек через LDB, меню аддонов или /sqol config. Также работает в Classic Era, Anniversary и Mists of Pandaria Classic.
localizedNotes.zhCN: 用声音感知任务进度：完成任务目标时播放工人语音，整个任务完成时再播放另一句（部落苦工："Work, work." / "Work complete."，或联盟工人："More work?" / "Job's done!"）。另有可开关的便捷功能：姓名板任务雷达、冒险回顾、任务进度着色、自动追踪与自动交接任务、射程图标与距离、鼠标提示显示目标与着色、物品等级与移动速度、经验/声望颜色、队伍等级、声望监视（可返回首选声望）、鼠标指针高亮、Wowhead链接，以及就位确认/排队倒计时。可通过 LDB、插件菜单或 /sqol config 打开设置窗口。也支持 Classic Era、Anniversary 和 Mists of Pandaria Classic。
localizedNotes.zhTW: 以聲音感受任務進度：完成任務目標時播放工人語音，整個任務完成時再播放另一句（部落苦工："Work, work." / "Work complete."，或聯盟工人："More work?" / "Job's done!"）。另有可開關的便利功能：名條任務雷達、冒險回顧、任務進度著色、自動追蹤與自動交接任務、射程圖示與距離、浮動提示顯示目標與著色、物品等級與移動速度、經驗/聲望顏色、隊伍等級、聲望監視（可返回偏好聲望）、游標高亮、Wowhead連結，以及準備確認/排隊倒數。可透過 LDB、插件選單或 /sqol config 開啟設定視窗。也支援 Classic Era、Anniversary 和 Mists of Pandaria Classic。

candidates.description: Installer and download page for WoW Forever addons

toc.title: Runback
toc.notes: The nearest graveyard and how long the run back from it takes, for you and for enemy players. Counts down when a player you killed, a group member or you can be back at the body. /runback for options.

tocs.title: Runback
tocs.notes: The nearest graveyard and how long the run back from it takes, for you and for enemy players. Counts down when a player you killed, a group member or you can be back at the body. /runback for options.

tocs.title: Swing Fix
tocs.notes: Keeps the game's own swing timer bars right: a full swing starts when a cast goes off, a parry brings the next swing forward, and attack speed changes are followed in the middle of a swing. /swingfix

tocs.title: SkillPath
tocs.notes: Levels a profession the cheapest way from your own recipes and auction prices: what to buy, what to craft and how many, what to sell. A tab in the professions window and in the auction house.

tocs.title: BiS Planner
tocs.notes: Your best gear for the stat weights and goals you set, planned across the whole set.

tocs.title: Follow Line
tocs.notes: Puts your party or raid in a follow line: one player orders the line, everyone else gets a Follow button (or key) for the player ahead of them, and the window shows who is on the line and who dropped off.

tocs.title: Friend Dots
tocs.notes: Turns friendly player nameplates into small class-coloured dots (or class icons) with a hairline health indicator.

tocs.title: Mana Piñata
tocs.notes: A swinging piñata over the nameplate of every enemy with Judgement of Wisdom, and a blue health bar: hit it, watch it burst, see the mana you got. /pinata for options.

tocs.title: Aura Advisor
tocs.notes: Tells a Paladin when another aura fits the fight better, from the damage your party takes, pushed-back casts and enemy casters. Reminds a tank of Righteous Fury and tracks your blessings on the party. /aura for options.

tocs.title: Cozy Counter
tocs.notes: Reminds you of Well Fed, the Cozy Sleeping Bag and the Camp Tent's rest, and counts the XP you lost without them. /cozy

tocs.title: Group Graves
tocs.notes: Marks where the members of your group died on the world map and keeps the marker after they release. Everyone with the addon shares the positions. /graves for options.

tocs.title: Quest Beacon
tocs.notes: Tells your group when you pick up a quest that can't be shared, and where to get it: quest giver, area, coordinates and a map pin anyone can click. /beacon for options.

tocs.title: Shield Shame
tocs.notes: Counts the damage and mana you throw away fighting without Lightning Shield, Water Shield or Mana Spring Totem, and mocks you for it. /shame

tocs.title: ForeverProbe (M3 disposable research probe)
tocs.author: WoW Forever open database project
tocs.notes: Read-only quest/API observation tool for the WoW Forever M3 experiment. Does not accept, complete, or turn in quests, and does not move the player. Uninstall after use.

tocs.title: ForeverProbeM4 (M4 pre-experiment: item rewards + gossip API)
tocs.author: WoW Forever open database project
tocs.notes: Read-only pre-M4 compatibility check. Tests item-reward capture at three lifecycle checkpoints and reconfirms gossip quest-list APIs. Never accepts, completes, or turns in quests; never calls GetQuestReward(); does not move the player. Distinct from M3's ForeverProbe -- can be installed alongside it…

tocs.title: Forever Probe M8.14 (Arrow and Drag)
tocs.author: WoW Forever open database project
tocs.notes: Disposable M8.14 research probe. Tests player facing convention, world-axis direction, rotatable arrow textures, arrow glyphs in the game font, right-click dragging of a frame and of a clickable button, and minimap geometry. Read-only: no quest or map actions. Remove after the M8.14 test.

tocs.title: Forever Probe M8.7 (QUEST_ACCEPTED)
tocs.author: WoW Forever open database project
tocs.notes: Disposable M8.7 research probe. Answers one question: does QUEST_ACCEPTED exist and fire reliably on WoW Forever? Read-only: never accepts, abandons, completes or turns in a quest itself. Remove after the M8.7 test.

tocs.title: ForeverProbeM4Rep (tiny follow-up: quest reputation rewards)
tocs.author: WoW Forever open database project
tocs.notes: Tests one question only -- can our normal read-only addon observation capture quest reputation rewards on WoW Forever? Read-only. Never accepts/completes/turns in quests. Never calls GetQuestReward(). Distinct from M3's ForeverProbe and both prior M4 probes -- can be installed alongside all of them…

tocs.title: Forever Probe M8.8 (QUEST_TURNED_IN)
tocs.author: WoW Forever open database project
tocs.notes: Disposable M8.8 research probe. Answers one question: is QUEST_TURNED_IN a reliable progression signal on WoW Forever? Read-only: never accepts, abandons, completes or turns in a quest itself. Remove after the M8.8 test.

tocs.title: Forever Probe M8.12 (Startup State)
tocs.author: WoW Forever open database project
tocs.notes: Disposable M8.12 research probe. Records what quest state is readable at each point of addon startup, and whether completed-quest flags are available. Read-only. Remove after the M8.12 test.

tocs.title: Forever Probe M8.10 (Travel & Arrival)
tocs.author: WoW Forever open database project
tocs.notes: Disposable M8.10 research probe. Answers one question: can TRAVEL arrival be detected on WoW Forever? Reads waypoint, super-track, navigation and player-position state; sets/clears the game's own map waypoint only on explicit /fprobe810 commands. Never touches quests. Remove after the M8.10 test.

tocs.title: Forever Probe M8.9 (Objective Progress)
tocs.author: WoW Forever open database project
tocs.notes: Disposable M8.9 research probe. Answers one question: can quest objective progress and completion be detected reliably on WoW Forever? Read-only: never accepts, abandons, completes or turns in a quest itself. Remove after the M8.9 test.

tocs.title: ForeverProbeM4Retry (tiny follow-up: guaranteed-reward empty-string retry)
tocs.author: WoW Forever open database project
tocs.notes: Tests one question only -- can a guaranteed quest reward whose item name initially reads as an empty string resolve later? Read-only. Never accepts/completes/turns in quests. Never calls GetQuestReward(). Distinct from M3's ForeverProbe and the M4 pre-experiment's ForeverProbeM4 -- can be installed…

toc.title: PadKeys
toc.author: wow-forever-data-science
toc.notes: Gamepad-style play on keyboard: key layout, soft targeting and key map. Add the PadKeys_* addons one at a time for the rest. Type /padkeys.

tocs.title: PadKeys
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: Gamepad-style play on keyboard: key layout, soft targeting and key map. Add the PadKeys_* addons one at a time for the rest. Type /padkeys.

tocs.title: PadKeys - Bar
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: One bar that shows the layer you hold (Cmd, Shift, Option, Ctrl), so you can hide Blizzard's bars. Needs PadKeys.

tocs.title: PadKeys - Fade
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: Fades Blizzard's bars, menus, unit frames, experience bar and quest tracker out until you need them (mouseover, combat, a target, loot, experience), with a label on each bar naming its PadKeys key; switches between your healer and other Edit Mode layouts by role. Needs PadKeys.

tocs.title: PadKeys - Look
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: The PadKeys look for the whole game: every font in Roboto, and black chat windows. Needs PadKeys.

tocs.title: PadKeys - Auras
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: Aura highlight, in combat too: your target's nameplate auras (C) and your debuffs (Ctrl+C); hold Shift+C for the tooltip. Needs PadKeys.

tocs.title: PadKeys - Combo
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: Combo points as a row of black and white pips, in place of Blizzard's. Rogues and druids in Cat Form. Needs PadKeys.

tocs.title: PadKeys - Debug
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: Saves Lua errors and blocked actions to SavedVariables, to read outside the game. Type /pkdebug.

tocs.title: PadKeys - Ready
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: Flashes a spell's icon in the middle of the screen as it becomes ready: reactive abilities (Overpower, Revenge, Execute, Riposte, ...) as they light up, and long cooldowns as they come back. Needs PadKeys.

tocs.title: PadKeys - Combat
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: Changes the UI when you enter and leave combat: a short "Combat" / "Out of Combat" text, and out of combat a list of missing or expiring long buffs for your class and group that fades out in combat. Needs PadKeys.

tocs.title: PadKeys - Cursor
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: Keyboard UI cursor through windows, and NPC dialogs, vendors and trainers as on the gamepad (F = A, Esc = B). Needs PadKeys.

tocs.title: PadKeys - Radial
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: Radials in the style of Blizzard's gamepad radial, in combat too: actions (G by combat, town errands while resting, Cmd+G), markers (Shift+G), main menu (Ctrl+G), consumables from your bags (5); a faint copy follows the mouse and lights the segment you need. Needs PadKeys.

tocs.title: PadKeys - Totems
tocs.author: wow-forever-data-science
tocs.notes: Blizzard's totem bar in the PadKeys look: square icons with a black border, no gold frames. Needs PadKeys.
